newsitem.title: UK: N.Ireland talks reject arms surrender plans.
newsitem.headline: N.Ireland talks reject arms surrender plans.

text.p: Anglo-Irish proposals on the surrender of guerrilla arms were rejected in a vote at Northern Ireland peace talks on Wednesday, a delegate said.
Opposition was led by pro-British unionists who feared the proposals would not force republican and loyalist guerrilla groups to hand over arms during talks on a political settlement.
David Adams of the Ulster Democratic Party told reporters all three unionist parties had voted against the plan.
"The governments' plan has been rejected," he said.
Britain and Ireland had proposed that parties to the talks surrender arms while negotiations progressed but unionists wanted them to be forced to guve up their guns.
